comments.subject: Public Comments Form
comments.comment: I seen that Little Valley park is now going to have a skate board park. You know the park gets vandalized nightly right! And yes nightly! I have talked to maintenance people that have had to clean it up. I seen a gang sign painted on a pole and he came over and painted over it. I quit taking my grandkids there as well as a lot of other residents because of the constant vandalism. The urinate on the playgrounds and toilet paper trees. My grandkids seen the toilet paper in the trees and cleaned it up. I didn't ask them to do they were raised better than these teens in Little Valley area. A skate park will not help with this problem. Skate parks are a hang out. Skate parks are a temporary for entertainment of a few and it gets abused and damaged. Talk to other towns and cities about this before you waist our tax money on this. Talk to the maintenance workers in the park. Visit the park on Sundays especially!
